messages:
Jenna (Sales): LeafBank just uploaded their security questionnaire (CAIQ + custom). Asking for intake + owner. They highlighted KMS/BYOK and data residency for the POC. Link: <https://files.redwood.com/leafbank/caiq-2026.pdf|CAIQ + attachments>
Lin (SE): Thanks — saw the file. A couple immediate asks from their infra team: 1) can we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private? 2) what’s the expected timeline to enable region-specific deployment for POC?
Jenna (Sales): Yep. They also asked for SOC2 and encryption in transit/at rest details. They want an ETA before signing the MSA.
security-queue-bot: New security intake created: intake_id=INT-2026-0423, priority=high, submitter=Jenna (Sales)
Marco (Security Eng): Assigned. I'll triage the CAIQ and return an owner + gaps doc by EOD tomorrow. Quick clarifying Q: is the POC going to run on Dedicated reserve or Private (VPC) for LeafBank? That affects BYOK options.
Priya (RevOps): Contract language requires a staging timeline in 2 weeks for enterprise trials. Sales asked for answers sooner if possible.
Lin (SE): POC is likely Dedicated first (reserved pool) to move faster, but LeafBank insists on key ownership eventually — so we'll need to confirm whether Dedicated supports customer-managed keys or if we need Private.
Marco (Security Eng): Short answer: BYOK is available on Private (customer KMS/HSM). Dedicated can support encrypted volumes with our keys today; BYOK on Dedicated requires an engineering change and an Ops playbook. I'll document the exact controls in the gaps doc.
Jenna (Sales): Can you include an estimated eng effort (S, M, L) for enabling BYOK on Dedicated so we can scope pricing/POC cost?
Marco (Security Eng): Will do. Also flagging two CAIQ sections that look incomplete: 
```
- SC-01: Data flow diagram (they attached a high-level diagram, but missing tokenization/encryption details)
- SC-06: Key lifecycle and rotation responsibilities
- CM-02: Change control for model updates in POC
```
I'll ask them for the missing artifacts.
Lin (SE): I can take the data-flow follow-up and ask for network diagrams and where PII touches. Short note template I use: "Please provide sequence diagram showing ingress, storage tier, and KV cache persistence, and call out any pseudonymization steps." Want me to send it?
Jenna (Sales): Yes please, send it and cc Marco. I'll mention timeline pressure.
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0423 status updated -> triage_in_progress (owner=Marco)
Marco (Security Eng): Also, LeafBank requested encryption algorithm details (e.g., AES-256 GCM, TLS 1.3). We'll attach our standard crypto spec and SOC2 evidence reference.
Priya (RevOps): For pricing — Sales needs a POC estimate if we have to fast-path BYOK for Dedicated. Jenna, can you confirm whether LeafBank will cover engineering onboarding costs?
Jenna (Sales): They indicated willingness to pay for expedited infra work; negotiating commercial terms now.
Marco (Security Eng): Action items: 1) I'll produce gaps doc + BYOK effort estimate (by EOD) 2) Lin will request data-flow + rotation policy artifacts from customer 3) Jenna to confirm payer for infra work and send MSA questions.
Lin (SE): On it — pinging their infra lead now.
Jenna (Sales): Pinged. Their infra lead (alex@leafbank.com) replied: "Can provide network diagrams and key ownership expectations by tomorrow noon."
Marco (Security Eng): Great — once we have network diagram and key lifecycle details, I'll finalize the control responses. If BYOK on Dedicated looks like a small engineering change, we can propose an accelerated scope and a one-off setup fee.
Priya (RevOps): Noted. I'll prep a price band for: (A) Dedicated w/our keys, (B) Dedicated + expedited BYOK, (C) Private/VPC w/BYOK.
Jenna (Sales): Thanks team. Will update LeafBank and loop back when I have confirmation on payer. :thumbsup:
Lin (SE): Sending data request now -> "Hi Alex — can you share: 1) sequence diagram for POC, 2) key rotation process, 3) expected region for deployment, 4) any compliance regs (PCI/SOC2/FedRAMP) to call out?"
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0423 comment added by Lin (SE)
Marco (Security Eng): If timeline slips, fallback plan: run POC in Dedicated with our keys + strict org-level access controls and document roadmap to BYOK. That usually satisfies initial risk reviews.
Jenna (Sales): Good fallback. I'll mark the opportunity as "POC pending security sign-off" and keep RevOps in loop.
security-queue-bot: INT-2026-0423 status updated -> awaiting_customer_artifacts
Lin (SE): Alex replied with attachments: network-diagram.pdf, key-policy.docx. Uploading to the intake folder. Link: <https://files.redwood.com/leafbank/intake/attachments|attachments>
Marco (Security Eng): Received. I'll review and update INT-2026-0423 with control mappings. Expect draft by 2026-04-24 18:00 UTC.
Priya (RevOps): Can you also include any contractual wording we should ask Legal to prepare around BYOK responsibilities? I can open a redline request once we have Marco's doc.
Marco (Security Eng): Yep — include a short clause template about key custody and rotation responsibilities. I'll add recommended language to the gaps doc.
Jenna (Sales): Appreciated. We'll aim to keep the POC start next week if all goes to plan. :rocket:
